Subject: Stepped POC milestones & ownership — BrightGrid

Thanks for the call earlier — great alignment on goals.

Recap / proposed POC approach (short):
- Objective: validate Redwood inference latency & cost at BrightGrid's 75k daily token throughput for search re-ranking and chat helper.
- Success criteria (candidate): 95% of inference calls < 200ms p50; per-token cost improvement vs current baseline >= 35%; no functional regressions on 6 eval prompts.
- Scope: 30-day stepped POC — sandbox -> limited trial -> final readout.

Milestone sketch and owners (please confirm):
1) Kickoff (Week 0) — 2026-12-03: Introductions, data handoff, sandbox access — Owner: Ben
2) Sandbox validation (Week 1) — automated perf test + smoke evals — Owner: Ben
3) Integration ramp (Weeks 2–3) — live traffic routing to Redwood dedicated instance (1 GPU pool) — Owner: Marissa
4) Readout & decision (Week 4) — final metrics, cost model, recommendation — Owner: Soojin

Next steps:
- Ben: provision sandbox credentials and perf job template by EOD 12/1. (Attachment: BrightGrid-POC-MAP-v1.pdf)
- Elena: confirm data export cadence & target kickoff date.
- Marissa: I’ll loop you into the eval checklist and weekly sync.

I’ll drop a kickoff invite once we lock the date. Any tweaks to owners or the success criteria? 

Best,
Soojin
